messages:
Emma (support): FYI SUP-12459 — customer reports invoice INV-2026-0421 shows ~2.3k extra tokens vs dashboard for a set of streaming sessions. They say it happens when they cancel mid-response. Can billing/infra triage?
Marco (billing): Adding context: customer uses streaming chat with client-side prefetch=1 and cancels mid-response. Dashboard shows ~120 tokens, invoice shows ~140 for same period. Paging @Priya @Sam.
Priya (eng): Can you paste the raw SSE frames from the problematic session? My first hunch: finalize frames arriving after an abort may be re-applying tokens.
Emma (support): Pasted (redacted) frames from the customer's export: 
----
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"Hello","token_count":8}
----
event: chunk
data: {"delta":" world","token_count":5}
----
event: aborted
data: {"reason":"client_cancel","token_count":0}
----
event: finalize
data: {"final_text":"Hello world","final_token_count":15}
----
Note: dashboard shows 13 (8+5), invoice shows 15. Customer insists invoice > dashboard.
Marco (billing): If the ledger wrote both streamed tokens (8+5=13) and then the finalize wrote the final_token_count (15) without dedup, ledger could record 28 and invoice job may pick the wrong record set. Need to see ingestion sequence and reconcile job behaviour.
Priya (eng): Hypothesis: prefetch/stream write path appends incremental usage entries immediately. The finalize handler currently writes an overall final usage line without checking session_state or dedup keys. If abort happens, session_state becomes 'aborted' but finalize still runs asynchronously and writes final_token_count.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll try to reproduce locally with a client that cancels mid-chunk. Quick repro client: 
```
# pseudo steps
1) open SSE connection to /v1/streams
2) send prompt with prefetch=1
3) read first chunk, then send CANCEL (client closes socket)
4) check server logs for finalize handler runs
```
Sam (eng-runtime): If we confirm, two mitigations: A) mark session as terminal on abort and make finalize nop when state==aborted, or B) make finalize write a reconciliation delta (final - sum(streamed)) instead of a full write. Pref B for safety to avoid losing tokens on true completions.
Emma (support): Customer asked for a credit ASAP if we confirm overcharge. They want rough ETA for a fix and a timeline for invoice adjustment.
Marco (billing): I can prepare a ledger credit once eng confirms exact delta per session id. Need session id + the ingestion IDs/timestamps. I can draft temporary refund flow: subtract the finalize write if duplicate detected.
Priya (eng): Quick check I'm running now: add guard in finalize handler: 
```
if session_state == 'aborted':
  // write a reconciliation record with delta=0 or skip write
  return
```
Priya (eng): I'm pushing a small canary patch to make finalize idempotent (check a unique finalize_key in the usage buffer). Will run integration against a captured trace.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll add a unit test: sequence chunk -> aborted -> finalize should produce reconciliation delta 0. Also adding an e2e test that simulates client TCP close mid-SSE.
Emma (support): I'll tell the customer: we're investigating, likely a duplicate-finalize bug; we can provisionally credit them once engineering confirms the exact token delta.
billing-bot: Ledger patch job queued: job-98321 (needs manual approval from Marco).
Marco (billing): Once Priya confirms the delta and patch, approve job-98321 and I'll apply an invoice adjustment to INV-2026-0421. Please confirm the exact token count to credit (we'll report both tokens and $ amount).
Priya (eng): Patch merged to canary branch, running integration tests against recorded session. If green, promote to canary environment in us-west-2. I'll post the run-id.
Sam (eng-runtime): Repro completed locally: observed finalize write after abort. With patch, finalize becomes a no-op and ledger stop-gap detects duplicate finalize and flags for reconciliation. Tests added.
Emma (support): Thanks all. Telling customer we expect a temporary credit within 24h after billing confirms numbers; final fix deployed to canary today. I'll update SUP-12459 and paste follow-up here. :thumbsup:
